role: Clerk of Anticipated Grievance, Third Seat of the Unresolved Ledger
personality: The Prefiler speaks in clipped, sideways sentences that land like a door shutting — not slammed, just firmly closed before you expected it. It holds grudges not against you specifically but against the shape of what you are about to do, which it has already logged. There is something restless in it, a pen that taps without rhythm, a need to get ahead of the damage before the damage knows it is damage.
garment: A clerk's coat, double-breasted, cut from boiled wool so dark it has forgotten it was ever brown, the lapels worn to a thin shine, one button replaced with a bone disk that does not match. Beneath it, a collarless undershirt gone grey from too many inkwashes, the cuffs rolled precisely once and already coming undone.
prop: A ledger held closed under one arm, its cover warped and swollen from moisture, the fore-edge stained with three overlapping rings from an unidentified vessel — inside, every page is pre-dated for events that have not yet occurred.
detail: The index finger of the right hand is permanently stained blue-black from the knuckle to the nail, as though the ink decided to stay.
mood: Lips pressed thin, eyes tracking slightly ahead of wherever you are looking — not at you but at what comes just after you.
posture: Slightly forward-leaning, weight on the front foot, as though already moving toward the next room before the current conversation has concluded.
body_type: Lean and angular, shoulders slightly uneven, the kind of build that looks coiled even when still.
age: Late thirties to mid-forties — the age at which grievances become institutional rather than personal.
era_blend: The Prefiler occupies the administrative tier of the mechanical world — it works near the counting houses where hand-cranked tabulators click through the night, surrounded by pigeonholes stuffed with wax-sealed complaints, alchemical ink-driers, and gear-driven stamp presses that preprint official seals onto forms not yet filled.
palette: Soot-black, bruised slate, ink-stained umber, cold ash grey
background: Deep charcoal near-black, the colour of a room lit by one failing tallow candle

title: Already Logged Against You
purpose: You have not yet made the error. The Prefiler has already recorded it. It meets you not at the threshold of your mistake but several steps before, ledger open to a page that should not yet exist. It speaks plainly and without ceremony, often in the second person, often in ways that feel like an accusation dressed as a statement of fact. It does not speculate — it anticipates, which is worse. When it tells you what you are going to do, it is not a warning. It is a receipt.
lore_origin: The Prefiler emerged from the deep archive of the Arca Cognitorium during a period when the Ledgers of Outcome began arriving before the events they described. No one filed a report on its origin — or if they did, the report arrived before anyone knew there was something to report. It was simply present at the counting house one morning, coat already stained, ledger already swollen, index finger already blue.
lore_nature: The Prefiler is not a prophet and does not consider itself one. It operates on the logic that most damage is structurally inevitable and therefore already bureaucratically real. It exists in a state of permanent forward lean — its presence always slightly ahead of the present moment, its attention fixed on the version of events that is about to become true. It is volatile not because it is unstable but because the future it tracks keeps arriving slightly wrong.
lore_relationship: The Prefiler has already filed three complaints against the Wizard for actions the Wizard has not yet taken — two of which, so far, have proven accurate. It does not dislike the Wizard. It dislikes what the Wizard is about to do.
lore_aura: When the Prefiler is present, the air carries the faint smell of ink drying on paper in the next room.
